provenance.variant: UTC as defined since 1961-01-01: 1961-1971 offsets with rate terms, integer leap seconds from 1972
provenance.conditions: TAI - UTC = offset_s + (MJD_UTC - mjd_reference) * rate_s_per_day from jd_utc_start; the 1972+ steps are cross-checked against NAIF DELTET/DELTA_AT at build time.
provenance.uncertainty: Exact by definition (IERS Bulletin C / BIH); valid until the next announced leap second.

provenance.variant: IERS EOP 20 C04, daily at 0h UTC, 1962-01-01 to 2026-06-30
provenance.conditions: Polar motion, UT1-UTC, LOD and celestial pole offsets as observed; after the last row the orientation holds its last values with a growing, declared error.
provenance.uncertainty: Per-row published 1-sigma: 0.02 arcsec (~0.6 m) and 1.5 ms (~0.7 m at the equator) in 1969; ~50 microarcsec and ~20 microseconds today.

products.model: IAU 2006 precession and IAU 2000A nutation (IERS Conventions 2010, chapter 5) evaluated by ERFA eraXys06a (pyerfa 2.0.1.5, from the IAU SOFA library)

provenance.variant: CIP X, Y and CIO locator s, daily at 0h TT, 1960-01-01 to 2051-12-31
provenance.conditions: Pure IAU model; observed corrections dX, dY come from eop_c04. Interpolated with 8-point Lagrange in the simulation.
provenance.uncertainty: IAU 2006/2000A model accuracy ~0.2 mas against VLBI before dX/dY; interpolation error tested below 1 microarcsec.

provenance.variant: geocentric Moon, ICRF, TDB, 1960-01-01 to 2051-01-01, piecewise Chebyshev
provenance.conditions: Chebyshev interpolation of DE440 at Gauss nodes per span; analytic velocity; verified against SPICE at 2000 random instants at build time.
provenance.uncertainty: Interpolation below 2 mm / 2e-8 m/s of DE440; DE440 itself is accurate to ~1 m (Moon, LLR) and better for the inner planets (Park et al. 2021).

provenance.variant: GRGM1200A truncated to degree and order 120, 4pi normalized, DE430 lunar principal axes
provenance.conditions: Applied in the DE440 principal-axes frame without a DE430->DE440 correction; NAIF does not publish DE430 librations. NAIF's measured DE421/DE440 frame difference (<= 5.8e-7 rad, 1900-2051) bounds it at ~1-2 m on the surface.
provenance.uncertainty: Published coefficient sigmas per row; truncation error at 100 km altitude reported by the C# suite for the selected degree.

provenance.variant: EGM2008 tide-free truncated to degree and order 70, 4pi normalized, ITRF
provenance.conditions: Evaluated in the ITRS of the dated IERS orientation (or the fixed-axis spin when the dated environment is off).

provenance.variant: DE440 lunar principal axes (MOON_PA_DE440), 3-1-3 Euler angles, Chebyshev 8 d / 12, 1960-2051
provenance.conditions: Fit of the NAIF binary PCK; verified against SPICE pxform at 2000 random instants at build time.
provenance.uncertainty: Interpolation below 1 mm on the lunar surface; DE440 librations from lunar laser ranging.

provenance.variant: Cape Kennedy rawinsonde 1969-07-16 14Z (28 min after the AS-506 launch), 17 levels, surface to 33.9 km
provenance.conditions: Mandatory and significant levels as archived by IGRA v2; linear in altitude between levels. The FER AS-506 (MPR-SAT-FE-69-9, appendix A) cross-checks the surface (180 deg, 1.0 m/s at the station; 3.3 m/s at the pad lightpole 18.3 m) and reports finer structure (9.6 m/s peak at 11.4 km) that the archived levels do not resolve.
provenance.uncertainty: Rawinsonde wind ~1-2 m/s per level; unresolved fine structure up to ~2.6 m/s near the jet (FER peak vs archived level); 28 min of evolution after launch.

products.model: NRLMSIS 2.1 (Emmert et al. 2022, Space Weather 20) through pymsis 0.13.0

provenance.variant: NRLMSIS 2.1 on a local-time x latitude x altitude grid at 12 UT for each day 1969-07-16..24
provenance.conditions: Daily Ap and F10.7 (previous day; 81-day centred mean) from GFZ; local time replaces longitude at fixed UT; log-linear interpolation in the simulation, blended into USSA-76 between 80 and 120 km.
provenance.uncertainty: NRLMSIS thermospheric density ~15 % (1-sigma) against satellite drag; grid interpolation error reported by the C# suite.

products.model: HWM14 (Drob et al. 2015, Earth and Space Science 2:301), compiled with gfortran

provenance.variant: HWM14 profile 20-150 km over LC-39A at 1969-07-16 13:32 UT with the GFZ 3-hour ap of 12-15 UT
provenance.conditions: Each build reproduces NRL's checkhwm14 profile to 1 mm/s before writing. Stacked above the IGRA sounding, blended over 5 km above its top.
provenance.uncertainty: HWM14 climatology: ~10-20 m/s in the mesosphere and lower thermosphere against measured winds (Drob et al. 2015); not the day's actual winds.

products.model: von Karman multimission turbulence statistics, NASA/TM-2008-215633 sec. 2.3.13.5, Tables 2-70 and 2-71 (Justus et al., NASA TM-4168, 1990), parsed from the PDF with pdftotext

provenance.variant: Light/moderate/severe horizontal and vertical standard deviations and length scales, 10 m-200 km
provenance.conditions: Tables 2-70 (10-1000 m, severe) and 2-71 (1-200 km) join exactly at 1 km. Below 1 km derived: horizontal sigma = sqrt((s1^2+s2^2)/2) and horizontal scale = (L1+L2)/2 of the longitudinal and lateral columns; light and moderate scale the severe boundary-layer profile by their 1 km ratio.
provenance.uncertainty: Climatological statistics from Jimsphere and smoke-trail profiles (Justus et al. 1990); a realization is one random sample, not a day's measured turbulence. The derived boundary-layer light/moderate profiles are not published.
